data.text:
M/S Gufran Buffalo Meat Shop Thru. ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. 
Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 6 February, 2024
Author: Vivek Chaudhary 
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:10807-Db
Court No. - 2 
Case :- Writ - C No. - 1160 of 2024
Petitioner :- M/S Gufran Buffalo Meat Shop Thru. Proprietor Mohd. Gufran 
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Administration U.
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vinay Prakash Shukla,Arun Kumar Yadav 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Hemendra Kumar Bhatt Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State/respondents and Sri Hemendra Kumar Bhatt, learned counsel appearing for the Nagar Palika Parishad,
Mahmudabad, District Sitapur. 
Petitioner has approached this Court for a mandamus claiming that he having a license from the Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Government of U.P. and the Nagar Palika Parishad should not interfere in his business.
M/S Gufran Buffalo Meat Shop Thru. ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 6 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187345947/
1 Learned counsel for the Nagar Palika Parishad states that there is a notice already given to the petitioner but it appears that a fresh notice is required to be given to the petitioner. He further states that the notice already given to the petitioner shall be withdrawn and only after giving a fresh notice and opportunity of hearing any action against the petitioner shall be taken.
The aforesaid statement is taken on record. 
In view thereof, the writ petition is consigned to record. 
(Om Prakash Shukla,J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 6.2.2024 Arjun/-
